app.name: Azkare
app.about_desc: Open-source app that shows Adhkar and Duas above your wallpaper and below your windows, with periodic reminder notifications.

settings.title: Settings
settings.general_language_desc: Language of the app. The layout flips automatically between right-to-left (Arabic) and left-to-right (English).
settings.general_autostart_label: Start Azkare automatically when I log in
settings.general_autostart_desc: When on, Azkare starts by itself every time you turn on your computer, so you never have to open it.
settings.overlay_mode_desc: Choose where you want to see Adhkar: on the desktop background, as notifications only, or both.
settings.overlay_backend_desc: How the text is drawn on your desktop. The default works out of the box. Choose eww only if you already use eww on Linux.
settings.overlay_position_desc: Pick a ready-made spot, or turn on drag mode to move the text anywhere with your mouse.
settings.overlay_drag_mode_desc: While on, drag the text with your mouse to where you want it, then turn this off to save the spot. (Not available on Wayland; use the ready-made spots.)
settings.overlay_monitor_desc: If you have more than one screen, choose which one shows the Adhkar.
settings.overlay_timer_desc: How long a Dhikr stays on screen before the next one replaces it.
settings.appearance_font_desc: The font of the text on your desktop. Beautiful Arabic fonts are built in; nothing to install.
settings.appearance_font_size_desc: Make the text larger to read from a distance, or smaller to take less room.
settings.appearance_color_desc: Pick a color that stands out on your wallpaper: light for dark wallpapers, dark for light ones.
settings.appearance_shadow_label: Add a shadow behind the letters
settings.appearance_shadow_desc: Keeps the text readable whatever the wallpaper looks like. Best left on.
settings.appearance_alignment_desc: How the lines sit inside the text box. "Center" suits most setups.
settings.notifications_info: Notifications appear when the display mode is "Notifications only" or "Both together" (change it in the Display tab).
settings.notifications_interval_desc: How long to wait between one notification and the next.
settings.content_categories_desc: Choose which kinds of Adhkar you want to see. If you turn them all off, every category is shown.
settings.content_shuffle_desc: Show the Adhkar in random order instead of a fixed sequence.
settings.content_show_source_desc: Shows each Dhikr's source in Arabic and English together under the text (المصدر: … | Source: …) whatever the interface language is, plus the repeat count when there is one.
settings.content_show_translation_desc: Shows the meaning in English under the Arabic text.
